BiblicalUsage: Sodi is the father of Gaddiel, one of the twelve spies sent into Canaan. His name appears once, in the list of the spies and their fathers. His son goes into the land and comes back with a report of fear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sodi matters because the spies' fathers are named, and the fear that followed is traced to real families.
